title: Ready to begin? Choose a package.
intro: Pick the package that fits, pay securely online and you're booked. You'll get a confirmation straight away, and we'll arrange your session times with you.
paymentNote: Payment is handled securely by Selar. You can pay by card or bank transfer. Not sure which package is right for you? Book an introductory call first.

packages.name: Therapy (Life Coaching) Package
packages.summary: Live your best life. Professional help with anxiety, depression, trauma and the things you've been carrying alone.

packages.name: Premarital Counselling Package
packages.summary: Build a strong foundation before you say "I do", with a structured programme and the SYMBIS assessment.

packages.name: Marriage Counselling Package
packages.summary: Newly married or many years in, work through the challenges threatening your union and divorce-proof your marriage.
